name: Human

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: Gain training in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: Gain one Origin feat of your choice.

reviewNotes: First-pass baseline draws on SRD 5.2.1. SRD 5.1 grants a different set of ability-score changes; those are not combined with this baseline.
3.5e bonus feat and additional skill points informed the modern Versatile and Skillful traits, but do not grant additional feats or skill-point pools.

The feat and skill selection contracts remain subject to the separate Feats, Skills, and character-creation passes. These are provisional Species traits and may be reassigned when Upbringing and Background receive their full review.
Languages and learned cultural benefits belong to independently selectable Upbringings; no Human-specific Upbringing or Ancestry is required by this first pass.
